svg.title: 没有这份技能时
svg.desc: 智能体一段话里夹了八个问题。要读完整段，才知道自己被问了什么。

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Noto Sans SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif
-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Noto Sans SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif

svg.text: 问题东一句西一句。不读完，不知道问了你什么。

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Noto Sans SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif
-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Noto Sans SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif
-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Noto Sans SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif
text.tspan: 好的，这次出行我先按经验帮你排一版，不对的你再改。先说人数，房型和餐厅桌位都

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Noto Sans SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif
text.tspan: 我没法按默认两人硬写。交通还没锁，高铁机票差很多

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Noto Sans SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif
text.tspan: 换城市只是耗时变了。玩什么我只是猜，你们是冲着吃

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Noto Sans SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif
text.tspan: 还是其实想购物夜生活？
活动更没定，体力差很多，

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Noto Sans SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif
text.tspan: 公司报销的话能开票的我提前筛，开不了的直接排

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Noto Sans SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif
text.tspan: 除。节奏我暂按适中。预算我心里没数，

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Noto Sans SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif
text.tspan: 再高我不敢擅自往上加。时间上住两晚就走，

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Noto Sans SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif
text.tspan: 先叫小王，有忌口补一句就行。

text.font-family: Georgia,'Songti SC','Times New Roman',serif
-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Noto Sans SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif
-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Noto Sans SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif
-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Noto Sans SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif
-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Noto Sans SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif
-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Noto Sans SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif
-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Noto Sans SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif

svg.text: 那就两人吧上海出发预算看情况发票你看着办

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Noto Sans SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif

svg.text: 温泉先算了称呼随便……漏了几问也说不准

text.font-family: -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB','Noto Sans SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif

svg.text: 你也只能写一段话回去。八个问题，对上了几个不好说。
